value.name: arrive at facility
value.description: Asha drives up to the facility and turns into the lot near the visitor entrance.
evidence: facility came up on her right
She turned in, found a space near the visitor entrance

value.name: pause before exiting car
value.description: After parking, Asha hesitates in the car, gripping the wheel and delaying getting out.
evidence: put the car in park, but did not reach for the door right away
her hands stayed at ten and two
she felt the cold curve of the wheel through the pads of her fingers

value.name: steady herself by counting
value.description: Asha watches the automatic doors and counts the seconds to calm herself, recalling a similar ritual before entering clients' homes.
evidence: Through the windshield she could see the automatic doors slide open for someone in scrubs and slide shut again
she counted the seconds it took
the way she sometimes counted at a client's threshold to steady her breath before she went in

value.name: remember appointment form
value.description: Asha thinks about the form Rosa gave her and decides to go inside despite her hesitation.
evidence: the form Rosa had named was in her pocket
the week was already moving toward Friday whether she opened the door or not

value.name: exit car and approach entrance
value.description: Asha gets out of the car and walks toward the facility entrance without checking her phone again.
evidence: Asha opened the door and stepped out onto the pavement
She pushed the door shut with her hip
walked toward the entrance without taking the phone out again

value.name: enter through automatic doors
value.description: Asha passes through the automatic doors into the building after they open for her.
evidence: The automatic doors parted at her approach
and she registered the small mechanical hesitation of the second panel and crossed under it anyway

value.name: enter warmer interior
value.description: Inside the facility, Asha feels the air change to a warmer, medicinal atmosphere as she continues inward.
evidence: Inside, the air changed—warmer, faintly medicinal—
and she let it close behind her
